# Offline Clinic Triage Assistant

Hackathon Brief – Round 2

## Problem statement

Rural health centers often lose connectivity for days. Build a local-first intake and triage helper that a nurse can
use on a low-spec laptop. The tool must flag high-risk symptoms with clear, explainable escalation rules, and it should
never transmit patient identifiers. “Offline” is not optional: the office workflow must be efficient even without a network.

## Requirements

- Must work completely offline on low-spec hardware.
- Must flag high-risk symptoms with explainable rules and clinician sign-off.
- Must never transmit patient identifiers externally.
- Should export a one-page referral summary.

## Deliverables

Working prototype, public repository, and a 3-minute demo video.

## Judging criteria

Impact 40%, Feasibility 30%, Innovation 20%, Presentation 10%.

## Important dates

Submissions close on 5 December 2026 at 6 pm. Finalists present on 12 December 2026.
